annotations.title: Write cells into a sheet tab

description: Sets cells in one tab of a sheet, by A1 address — values or formulas ('=SUM(B2:B9)'). Additive and surgical: only the addressed cells change. Check napkin_sheets_schema first so you know the tab names and where data ends; put headers in row 1 when creating a new region. To build a whole small table, write header cells + data cells in one call.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

tabName.description: Tab name (defaults to the first tab).

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: napkin_sheets_set_cells
title: Write cells into a sheet tab
